title: The Complaint about the Itchy Tag

moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Isla about explanation of an itchy tag that took a while to get to the point. Isla wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
